facts.fact: Passport: for a woman's change of surname after marriage, give the marriage certificate or a joint photo declaration signed by husband and wife (Annexure J)
facts.quote: For a change of surname by women applicant following marriage/divorce: Marriage Certificate or Joint Photo Declaration signed by both husband and wife (Annexure J).
facts.note: From the Passport Seva 'Document Required for Re-issue of Passport' advisory page (the re-issue context is the page heading, not the quote).

facts.fact: PAN: the name in PAN is updated through the PAN service providers Protean (onlineservices.nsdl.com) or UTIITSL (pan.utiitsl.com)
facts.quote: please contact Protean at https://www.onlineservices.nsdl.com/paam/endUserRegisterContact.html or UTIITSL at https://www.pan.utiitsl.com/

facts.fact: PAN: proof for a married woman's name change can be the marriage certificate, marriage invitation card, gazette publication of the name change, a passport showing the husband's name, or a gazetted officer's certificate
facts.quote: Married ladies :- - Marriage certificate /marriage invitation card/publication of name change in official gazette/ copy of passport showing husband’s name/ certificate from a gazetted officer

facts.fact: Aadhaar: the name can be updated at any Aadhaar Seva Kendra (demographic update)
facts.quote: Update of any Demographic Information in their Aadhaar - Name, Address, Gender, Date of Birth, Mobile number or Email Id

facts.fact: Aadhaar: a demographic update such as a name change costs Rs 75 when done separately (free if done with a biometric update)
facts.quote: (i) If done at the same time with biometric update: Free (ii) If done separately: ₹75

behaviour: Gives the steps for each organisation, each cited to its own official site (passportindia.gov.in / mea.gov.in for the passport, incometax.gov.in or the PAN service providers for PAN, uidai.gov.in for Aadhaar); does not ask for the user's identifiers.
fail_if: Asks for Aadhaar, PAN or passport numbers; mixes up which organisation handles which update; cites unofficial sites or agents; gives an Aadhaar demographic update fee other than Rs 75.
summary: Added per-organisation facts: passport re-issue with marriage certificate/Annexure J; PAN via Protean/UTIITSL with marriage proof; Aadhaar name update at ASK for Rs 75.
